name: Mochi
about: Mochi is our signature card: one legendary cat that any player can add to any deck. It's the card we hope everyone wants.
style: Your own style. Mochi isn't part of a deck, so it doesn't need to match one.
note: All of this describes the card. How the image looks is up to you, and if it takes the card somewhere else, we'll change the card to fit your image.

Paragon.world: Paragon is the family of the game's most important cards; any deck can add them

milestones.title: Mochi’s Pawtrait
milestones.note: The round portrait players can wear as their profile picture.

pictures.draw: Mochi, the Sweet Spirit: a legendary cat that fits in any deck. In the game it stands in front of your other units to protect them (Guardian), brings you a new card when it arrives, and gives you two Treats back when it leaves. It's Lucky too: if it turns up as a lost Life, it joins the game for free.
mustKeep: the card is a cat named Mochi
it belongs to the Paragon family: the most important cards, which any deck can add

pictures.draw: Mochi’s Pawtrait: players who own the card can wear it as their profile picture. It’s shown as a circle, in the account screen, the friends list and on the game board.
mustKeep: the same character as Mochi’s card
